scenes.title: What gets audited
lines: Thenar sells robot demonstration data, and its own server is the party being checked. So a Chainlink CRE workflow audits it.

scenes.title: cre workflow simulate --broadcast
notes: CRE CLI SIMULATION · REAL BROADCAST TO MONAD
lines: This is the CRE CLI running the corpus-audit workflow. On a cron trigger, every node fetches the served episode hashes over HTTP and rebuilds each task's Merkle root itself, with consensus on identical roots.

Then it reads the roots our verifier committed on Monad, in one Multicall3 call, decides a verdict per task, and writes a report to the CorpusAudit contract on Monad testnet. Here it audited three tasks, in transaction 0xf154.

scenes.title: The verdict, read back by the app
lines: The app reads the verdict back. For this task it is uncommitted: the episodes are served, but no root is committed yet, and CRE says so on chain, beside the data, for any buyer to read.
